description:
Goal
Make struct dispatch test nominal identity before structural map shape so a plain map cleanly misses a struct clause.

Current signal
fixtures2/behavior/membership_operator.fz is still deferred on fz-bv3. Direct repro:
- fz2 interp fixtures2/behavior/membership_operator.fz prints the first four booleans, then fails with match_error: expected struct Range when map membership reaches the Range arm.
- fz2 run fixtures2/behavior/membership_operator.fz exits 0 but only prints the first four of six expected lines.

Root cause
World::struct_value_ty represents a struct as nominal impl-target identity union tuple evidence union map evidence. Region::Type dispatch currently treats the structural map arm as enough to enter a struct clause. For a receiver that can be Range|Map, a plain map can satisfy the structural map test and then panic during Range field extraction.

Required work
- Extend dispatch/type lowering so Region::Type over a struct value tests the nominal opaque tag before any tuple/map field projection.
- A non-matching map must take the miss edge, not enter the struct arm and fail later.
- Re-enable membership_operator and enumerable_protocol_dispatch defers only after interp/run/build agree with the goldens.

Checks
- Focused struct-vs-map regression: %Box{} arm followed by wildcard must return the wildcard for a plain map.
- cargo test --test fixture_matrix membership_operator enumerable_protocol_dispatch -- --nocapture, or equivalent focused matrix runs.
- cargo test --lib and cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings.
title: Struct dispatch must test nominal tag before map shape
